title: Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst

descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about transforming data into a true asset that drives innovation and growth? Do you have the expertise and vision to help shape the future of data management for a leading global asset manager? If so, we want you to join our Chief Data Office (CDO) team as a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst. We at UBS Asset Management believe that data is not just information – it’s one of our most valuable assets. Our mission is to establish data as a value driver and enabler of strategic innovation across the firm. We are seeking a driven, forward-thinking individual who can help us build the next generation of data platforms and unlock the potential of AI and GenAI for the future. Your role: As a Senior Product Owner / Lead Business Analyst, you will play a key role in building and managing the data foundation of UBS Asset Management, working at the intersection of data, technology, and business.
• Your responsibilities will include: - Managing the Roadmap: Define and prioritize the product roadmap for all applications supporting our data foundation, ensuring alignment with the CDO’s strategic vision. - Business Analysis: Collaborate with key stakeholders across UBS Asset Management to analyze business requirements, define use cases, and translate them into actionable projects. - As-Is Process & Data Flow Analysis: Conduct comprehensive assessments of current data flows, processes, and systems to identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency. - Target Operating Model & Data Architecture Design: Work closely with data engineers and architects to design the target operating model and data architecture that will transform our data management landscape. - Data Analytics & Insights: Leverage data analytics to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in data, providing insights that drive business decisions and improve data quality. - Documentation & User Support: Ensure all data systems and processes are well-documented, including process flows, data dictionaries, and user guides. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and assist end-users during transitions to new platforms.
